sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial CGI Visual Effects and 3D Character Animation

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law heritage with French civil law influences; codified under the International Companies Act 1992)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China–Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 2006, in force 2007)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, multilateral free trade agreement in force 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement (multilateral preferential trade union)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act, Act No. 17 of 2014, as amended (the 'AML/CFT Act'); International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015 and the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2021; Financial Services Commission Act [Cap. 290]; AML/CFT Regulations and Beneficial Ownership Code of Practice issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport (with colour scan) of each proposed director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the document holder’s jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if originating state is not a party to the Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker’s reference/recent bank statement for each UBO evidencing source of funds (issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original issuing bank or licensed financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Corporate Registry Extract for any body-corporate shareholder or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry in the shareholder/director’s country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of lawful source of funds and compliance with AML/CFT undertakings (Form VFSC/AML-014)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed UBO or director before a notary public; counter-signed by the VFSC-licensed registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK Treasury Sanctions List and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit’s local sanctions database. Enhanced Due Diligence is required for all PEPs and their family members/close associates, including verification of source of wealth and senior management approval. Screening must be repeated at onboarding and thereafter on a rolling 90-day basis. Failure to screen is a criminal offence under the AML/CFT Act.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu / eVFSC Direct)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in Latin script (English or French). Bislama may be used only as a secondary trading name. Names must be distinguishable and not misleading; transliteration into Vanuatu official languages is not mandatory for the legal name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Investment Fund, Mutual Fund, Asset Management
University, College, Institute (where implying state or academic recognition)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may submit a written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days, attaching evidence of prior use or the requested entitlement. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 7 working days. A further appeal may be made to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by originating summons within 21 days from the adverse determination. Alternatively, the applicant may file a fresh reservation with a revised name at no additional statutory fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A licensed agent’s physical address may serve as the registered office; remote/virtual office arrangements are permitted for a non-resident IC in the 3D animation and VFX sector, provided the agent maintains the registered office in Port Vila and the company carries on no business with residents of Vanuatu. This is standard practice and does not trigger local substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – approximately 10-15% annual probability under VFSC risk-based supervision; nevertheless, the registered agent must retain UBO records, board resolutions, and accounting vouchers at the registered office for immediate production upon a VFSC inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the VFSC Fees Schedule (Cap. 222 Regs.)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing and certificate of incorporation fee (International Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office services (first year, provided by licensed agent in Port Vila)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for VFSC-licensed agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent corporate secretary and AML/CFT compliance officer (first year)
Notarisation and Hague Apostille of UBO due-diligence bundle (four documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and respective Apostille issuing authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fee plus Apostille certificate fee (varies by originating jurisdiction)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening for directors, shareholders and UBOs up to five individuals
International courier (DHL/FedEx) for certified originals to Port Vila
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate from major origin countries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation or transliteration certification (only if documents are not in English/French)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator in the origin jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Vanuatu), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2013; ss. 6-7 (incorporation by Articles), s. 29 (registered office), s. 55 (directors); Companies and Professional Trustees Licensing Act [Cap. 236] (licensed registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (VFSC Form IC-1), lodged by a VFSC-licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; shares of no par value may be issued nil-paid or partly paid, no escrow deposit of capital is required, and no capital duty is payable on incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers to the Articles of Incorporation be allotted the initial shares as set forth in the Register of Members at par value per share now authorized. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be established at the offices of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that such agent maintain all statutory registers. RESOLVED FURTHER that the persons named in the consent minutes be appointed as first directors of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors are authorized to open corporate bank accounts, execute client contracts, and affix the common seal. RESOLVED FINALLY that the Articles of Incorporation be adopted and incorporation costs be approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Structure Design
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, acting through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to run an availability search, reserve the chosen corporate name, and confirm the class and number of authorized shares, the Port Vila registered office address, and the first director details in the draft Articles.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd'
Certified passport copy of the intended shareholder
Duty of care and KYC forms of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or offensiveness, the agent re-submits up to three alternative names within 24 hours at no additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscribers and licensed registered agent; signatures witnessed before a Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Articles of Incorporation with company name, objects covering commercial CGI visual effects and 3D character animation, no-par-value share capital, registered office address in Port Vila, and registered agent details; each subscriber signs in the presence of the agent and a notary, who attests the executed instrument.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the notary or agent identify incomplete objects clauses or share particulars, the Articles are re-executed by way of a corrected counterpart before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Articles, pays the VFSC registration fee of approximately USD 400, and obtains the VFSC stamped acknowledgment; applications may be submitted electronically through the VFSC portal or in paper form at the registry counter.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form IC-1 with Articles of Incorporation
Certified passport copies of subscribers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query letter, the agent files written responses within 14 days; minor defects are corrected by filing amended schedules without loss of the original priority date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry / licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the agent then draws the Register of Members, Register of Directors, and Register of Charges, prepares the common seal, and delivers the certificate pack to the company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, the agent files a formal rectification request and VFSC issues a corrected certificate within two working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directors of the International Company; minutes kept by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting; pass the pro-forma first board resolution approving share allotment, adoption of the registered office, and appointment of officers; sign the minutes, issue share certificates, and file any register updates with the agent.
required_dossiers: Share certificates issued to initial members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed director declines appointment, the board appoints an alternate director by written resolution; if minutes are queried by the agent, a corrected unanimous written resolution is filed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 5911 digital content production; for physical studio premises, the Port Vila Municipal Council (Trading Licences Division) is the relevant authority, with VFSC only if incidental financial services activities are added.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license is required for commercial CGI and 3D animation services; a Municipal Business/Trading Licence is required only for a physical studio in Port Vila.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from formal EIA; office-based software and animation activities fall below the mandatory EIA thresholds under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations (Cap. 283).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC emission thresholds, or hazardous waste streams arise from rendering and animation work; compliance is required with the Waste Management Regulations for office refuse and e-waste, with disposal channeled to DEPC-approved recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For any physical premises: Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Police Fire and Emergency Services, a structural load inspection certificate covering equipment and server racks, and workplace registration with the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act; remote-only operations require none of these clearances.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official e-portal: www.gov.vu / VIRD e-Services portal (tax administration services), with company registration administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is wholly tax-exempt and is not issued a domestic income-tax TIN; its juridical identifier is the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation number. If the IC voluntarily registers for VAT (to recover input VAT on local studio leases, equipment, utilities, or contracted VFX labor), the foreign beneficial owner must file Form VAT-01 with VIRD together with the certificate of incorporation, board resolution authorizing registration, registered office address, and a statutory declaration confirming non-resident ownership and the absence of Vanuatu-source domestic activity. VIRD issues a VAT Registration Certificate bearing a 9-digit VAT ID. Foreign entities (non-IC) engaged in taxable activity in Vanuatu must register for VAT once taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold, and must also obtain a Business Licence from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission / municipal licensing authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The IC is ring-fenced as 100% exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, including corporate income tax (none exists), capital gains tax (none exists), dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax (none exists), and stamp duty on share transfers. The IC is prohibited from trading with Vanuatu residents, holding land interests, and carrying on business from a physical Vanuatu office; all substantive commercial activity for 3D animation/VFX export must occur outside Vanuatu or with non-resident counterparties. This is an entity-level permanent statutory exemption, not a pass-through election, and it coexists with the fact that Vanuatu's ordinary domestic tax system also imposes no corporate income tax on resident companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no US-style check-the-box or OECD hybrid-mismatch election regime. Available elections: (1) election to incorporate as an International Company under ss. 5-10 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222], conferring statutory tax-exempt status; (2) voluntary VAT registration election under the VAT Act (Form VAT-01) allowing an exporter to register below the compulsory threshold to claim input credits; (3) election under the VAT Act No. 11 of 2024 for a non-established/supplier-of-imported-services to self-assess reverse-charge VAT where applicable; (4) election under s. 47 of the IC Act to maintain books, records, and share capital in any foreign currency; (5) no hybrid mismatch election is recognized, but a 0% effective tax rate eliminates any hybrid duduction/offset outcome in practice.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 2024 (replacing the former VAT Act [Cap 246])
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 2,500,000 (Vanuatu Vatu) of annual taxable turnover within any consecutive 12-month period (legacy Cap 246 threshold, carried forward under commencement regulations of the 2024 VAT Act); a person commencing business must register if expected first-3-month turnover exceeds VUV 2,000,000. An offshore IC that exclusively supplies zero-rated animation/VFX services to non-resident clients is not compulsorily registrable, but may elect voluntary registration for input credit recovery.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The VAT Act No. 11 of 2024 mandates a phased electronic invoicing regime. VIRD may designate 'prescribed taxpayers' (generally by annual turnover class) who must issue invoices exclusively through VIRD-approved electronic billing systems or fiscal devices integrated via certified APIs, transmitting invoice data to the VIRD central fiscal clearance platform and receiving a digital stamp/QR-code token for each transaction in near-real-time (within 24 hours of issuance). Non-prescribed taxpayers may issue manually numbered PDF/paper invoices but must report digital VAT returns via the VIRD e-portal monthly or quarterly. Detailed API specifications and the phased go-live timetable are set out in the Tax Administration (Electronic Invoicing) Regulation 2025; cross-border service suppliers outside Vanuatu are outside the domestic e-invoicing cleanse unless reverse-charge registration applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT) applies to (a) exported goods supported by customs export documentation; (b) services supplied to a non-resident person who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and where the benefit of the service is not enjoyed in Vanuatu (export of services); and (c) services physically performed entirely outside Vanuatu. Commercial 3D animation and CGI/VFX production for overseas studios qualifies as a zero-rated export of services where: (i) the contracting client is a non-resident and not a Vanuatu VAT-registered person; (ii) the final rendered media files are delivered digitally to a foreign recipient; (iii) the intellectual property and commercial exploitation rights are held offshore; and (iv) consideration is payable from outside Vanuatu in foreign currency. No customs clearance is required for service zero-rating; substantiation is purely documentary and must be retained for the statutory audit retention period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Goods (if any physical media shipped): Validated Vanuatu Customs Export Declaration (Form CED-01) with electronic lodgement reference, commercial invoice, Bill of Lading or Air Waybill, packing list

Services: Executed international service contract identifying the non-Vanuatu principal place of business and ISIC 5911 scope; itemized zero-rated invoice bearing the IC VAT ID (if registered); inward payment evidence (SWIFT MT103 or Wise B2B statement) proving foreign-source settlement; digital delivery log with file hashes and geolocation metadata of the 3D renders delivered to the overseas studio; VIRD zero-rated supply schedule (Form VAT-21) where applicable
Supporting corporate evidence: Certificate of Incorporation, register of non-resident shareholders/beneficial owners, and annual return confirming no Vanuatu domestic trading activity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu's Exchange Control Act [Cap 45] imposes no statutory 180-day FX repatriation obligation; the 180-day figure serves only as the firms internal compliance benchmark for invoicing-to-settlement discipline. VIRD audit scrutiny on zero-rated export claims focuses on proof of non-resident recipient status, actual offshore exploitation, and full traceability of inward FX. Under the VAT Act No. 11 of 2024, a false zero-rating claim triggers a tax shortfall penalty of up to 200% of the VAT under-claimed, a further late-payment penalty of up to 50%, and statutory interest on the unpaid amount. Criminal sanctions include fines of up to VUV 10,000,000 and imprisonment for up to 10 years for knowingly furnishing false export documents to VIRD. Retrospective reassessment may be made for up to 5 years (extended to 7 years for fraudulent conduct), and directors/beneficial owners of an IC are jointly and severally liable where the IC knowingly misrepresented its zero-rated export status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], is the sole central monetary authority. The RBV administers the exchange-control framework through the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 92] and supervises all licensed commercial banks, foreign exchange dealers, and money remitters operating in Vanuatu, while the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately regulates the International Company registry.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is convertible for current international transactions under Vanuatu's IMF Article VIII obligations, and domestic law does not impose a formal distinction between capital-account and current-account convertibility. Profit remittance by non-resident shareholders of an International Company is not statutorily restricted; however, in practice the remitting bank requires a VFSC-issued tax clearance or tax-exempt status certificate, a certificate of incumbency, a board resolution authorizing the dividend, and proof that the underlying profits were earned from non-Vanuatu sources. Deep offshore convertibility is limited by the thin domestic interbank market, the lack of a deliverable offshore VUV market, and the global correspondent-bank de-risking environment; therefore the recommended treasury currency is USD, with VUV conversion reserved for local operating expenses.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender regime and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Proceeds from exported commercial 3D animation services may be retained indefinitely in VUV or any foreign currency in an account at an authorized dealer. The Exchange Control Act [Cap. 92] only requires declarative reporting or licensing approval for specific capital transactions by residents, and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] expressly exempts non-resident-owned International Companies from exchange-control licensing for offshore receipts, provided the funds flow through an RBV-authorized banking channel.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Corporate Operational Account and Foreign Currency Deposit Account
Capital Escrow Account / FX Trade Settlement Account
Operational Account (VUV; FX sub-ledger after compliance approval)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Overall feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Wise Business (Wise_B2B) is the only recognized fintech EMI usable as a secondary settlement rail for this entity, with a Medium rating: it supports inbound/outbound wire routing in USD and VUV, but it cannot serve as the primary treasury account because it has no licensed branch in Vanuatu, its verification engine is unpredictable for VFSC-registered International Companies, and VUV balance capabilities are narrow. Other non-bank EMIs such as Airwallex, Currenxie, Mercury, and Payoneer are rated Low viability; most treat Vanuatu as a Pacific high-risk jurisdiction and will decline or freeze an account once the VFSC certificate of incumbency reveals an offshore International Company. The recommended structure is: foreign client payments arrive via Wise_B2B or SWIFT into an ANZ/BSP/Bred USD account in Vanuatu, with VUV conversion performed only by the licensed domestic bank for local payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Fully remote opening without any in-country visit is not available at tier-1 domestic banks. In practice, at least one natural-person director or a locally licensed professional agent holding a wet-ink Power of Attorney must appear physically at the bank's Port Vila branch for the initial KYC interview. Video KYC and notarized passport copies are accepted only for additional signatories and remote directors. ANZ, BSP, and Bred allow a hybrid route: one in-person interview by a director or agent, plus couriered original board resolutions and notarized beneficial-ownership documents within 14 days. NBV is the strictest and mandates physical appearance of both the director and the ultimate beneficial owner before account activation. A Vanuatu-registered corporate services agent is therefore essential for practical onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell risk: International Company with nominee directors, no economic substance, and no Vanuatu operating footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance dossier comprising the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Incumbency, register of directors and shareholders, detailed business plan for the commercial 3D animation studio, signed production service agreements with foreign clients, evidence of studio facilities or a Vanuatu virtual office, local agent attestation, and a project-milestone contractual chain consistent with ISIC 5911.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for the initial capital injection and no corporate track record
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized source-of-wealth affidavit for each shareholder, six months of personal or corporate bank statements, audited accounts or tax records where available, share subscription agreements, a bank reference from the remitting institution, and a traced fund-flow statement showing the credit to the Vanuatu operating account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border digital revenue without verifiable invoicing, typical of remote VFX and animation services
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: E-invoice and order database including signed master service agreements, statements of work per animation project, milestone invoices, software and render-farm usage records, platform subscription evidence, SWIFT MT103 credit confirmations, and a written compliance statement confirming that no Vanuatu-source revenue is generated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid pass-through movement of funds, mixed remittance purpose codes, and VUV/USD layering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury clearing mandate, documented FX and hedging policy, project-linked payment ledger, an entity-level AML/CFT policy compliant with the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act No. 31 of 2017, and a rolling 12-month cash-flow projection reconciling inbound client payments to outbound subcontractor disbursements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Screening flags triggered by Vanuatu's offshore-company classification and adverse EU or international jurisdiction listings
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A consolidated compliance package containing clean OFAC/FATF/UN sanctions screening results, confirmation from the VFSC of the entity's good standing and tax-exempt status, tax residency certification showing no Vanuatu tax liability on offshore receipts, and an explanatory memo classing ISIC 5911 animation services as Low_Risk_Standard activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital should be routed as a SWIFT MT103 wire credit or Wise_B2B transfer to the beneficiary Vanuatu bank, using ISO 20022 purpose category CAPC for capital payments and the free-text narrative 'Share capital contribution to Vanuatu International Company'. Funds are accepted in USD or other foreign currency and are credited after the bank completes source-of-funds verification. First-time inbound transactions above VUV 1,000,000 are subject to enhanced transaction monitoring and a standard one-to-three business-day verification hold. The receiving bank requires the share subscription agreement, a board resolution evidencing the allotment, and a remitting-bank reference before releasing funds for discretionary use.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails for outbound trade settlements are SWIFT MT103 single customer credit transfers routed through the correspondent network of ANZ, BSP, or Bred, and the Wise_B2B rail for sub-USD 50,000 disbursements to non-bank vendors. USD outflows clear through the New York correspondent channel, while AUD/EUR outflows clear through Sydney or European correspondent banks. Commercial Letters of Credit are permissible but unusual for animation services; for larger milestone-based production projects, an unconfirmed or confirmed LC may be issued to a visual effects subcontractor. Every outbound payment must reference the underlying project contract, present the relevant commercial invoice, and match the approved beneficiary database to satisfy the receiving bank's transaction monitoring.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable VUV/USD spot FX contracts executed with an RBV-licensed dealer bank on the same-day or next-day conversion of client receipts into VUV for local operating expenses.
Outright deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts with tenors of up to 12 months, collateralized by confirmed animation project receivables and board-approved treasury authorization.
Cross-currency cash-flow swaps between USD inflows and VUV operating expenditure, subject to the domestic bank's credit-line approval and documented underlying trade obligations.
Natural-hedge treasury policy utilizing USD-denominated invoicing with VUV conversion limited to domestic disbursements, thereby avoiding any synthetic offshore VUV leg.

Synthetic VUV/USD non-deliverable forward booked with a non-resident prime broker using USD margin collateral, legally permissible for hedging purposes but practically unavailable through Vanuatu licensed banks and therefore classified as a contingent rather than core instrument.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (prescribed VFSC form) disclosing constitution, registered office, registered agent, directors, issued share capital, and beneficial ownership profile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; no prorated extension for new or dormant companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty assessed under the VFSC fee schedule; failure to file for two consecutive anniversaries exposes the company to administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1992 (as amended), with restoration subject to registry approval and reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Reconfirmation (agent-signed declaration attaching the completed annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual return, no later than the anniversary date plus 30 calendar days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to reconfirm the Vanuatu registered office may be treated as absence of a compliant registered address, enabling the Registrar to commence strike-off within six months; the licensed agent must also report the company to the VFSC as non-compliant

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit applies to Vanuatu International Companies; independent certified audit is triggered only when mandated by a shareholders' resolution (e.g., holders of at least one-quarter of voting power), by a secured lender's covenants, or by an applicable VFSC license condition; prudential thresholds do not apply because the company is tax-exempt and files no financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Any recognized framework may be used for management accounting; IFRS as issued by the IASB and US GAAP are both acceptable; no local commercial GAAP is separately promulgated for International Companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must hold current know-your-client and beneficial ownership information and must update the internal UBO register immediately upon every transfer or allotment of shares; an annual written confirmation signed by the beneficial owner(s) is collected with each annual return cycle and the updated UBO schedule is lodged with the VFSC; a transfer without prior notice to the agent is ineffective against the company until registered
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of members' and directors' resolutions
Registered Office register containing the constitution, minutes, and accounting records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800-1,500 per annum for the Vanuatu licensed registered agent, registered office, and the preparation and lodgment of the annual return
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable by default; voluntarily procured certified accountant's report or independent audit typically ranges from USD 2,500 to USD 6,000 for a small to mid-size animation and VFX holding entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for an International Company (IC). Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend distribution tax, or interest/royalty withholding tax. The IC is statutorily tax-exempt under the International Companies Act 2007, as amended. Commercial 3D animation and VFX services supplied to non-resident clients are exported services and fall outside Vanuatu's 15% VAT charge; no CIT-related incentive mechanism is needed because no charge arises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A – Vanuatu prescribes no annual corporate income tax return. The only recurring official filing relevant to an IC is the International Company Annual Return, submitted to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the VFSC e-portal or through a licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual administrative filing only; no periodic tax return filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC annual returns and renewal fees are due within 30 days after the anniversary of the company's registration in Vanuatu. No CIT filing deadline exists because no CIT is chargeable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, registration number, incorporation date, and the registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name shown on the certificate of incorporation; non-resident shareholders are not required to submit any resident tax schedule to VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and contact details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent maintaining the company file.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be physically present in Vanuatu; non-resident directors may rely on that agent for all domestic correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, residential address, nationality, and date of appointment of each director and of the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-residents and are not required to hold Vanuatu work permits for directorship-only functions; the IC Act still requires disclosure of their particulars.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D – Shareholders and Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder names, share classes, number of shares, and ultimate beneficial owner identification for AML/CFT and CRS/FATCA purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the ultimate beneficial owner information to the registered agent in the prescribed beneficial ownership form; nominee arrangements must be separately disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Short statement of the actual business activity, confirming that the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu with Vanuatu residents except in permitted offshore capacity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the commercial activity as 'Commercial CGI, 3D character animation, and VFX production for non-resident clients'; confirm that all revenue is derived outside Vanuatu's domestic tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent declaration that the company has complied with the IC Act, AMLCFT Regulations, CRS/FATCA reporting, and has maintained accounting records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident signature is needed if the agent certifies; the company must nonetheless supply records to the agent promptly.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the VFSC annual return attracts late filing surcharges prescribed under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations, with continuing daily or monthly surcharges until filed. Continued default may lead to strike-off, deregistration, and compulsory liquidation. Knowingly submitting a false annual return is an offence under the IC Act, punishable by fine and imprisonment, and the responsible director or agent may be disqualified.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on dividends declared or paid by an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network, so there is no domestic DTA relief claim form for an IC. Because no Vanuatu withholding tax exists, no refund or treaty relief application is required at source. Where a foreign recipient bank or tax authority requires proof of tax status, obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption / Certificate of Corporate Status from the VFSC or the Vanuatu Government's competent tax policy unit; the ultimate shareholder must otherwise rely on unilateral foreign tax credit rules in its own country of tax residence. A Vanuatu tax residence certificate is generally not available because the IC is not a tax-resident company under a domestic income tax law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border interest, royalties, management fees, and technical service fees paid by a Vanuatu IC. No reduced treaty rate is applicable because no treaty withholding rate is required; however, the recipient's home jurisdiction may impose foreign withholding or enforced CFC/GAAR adjustments if the recipient is a sham or lacks substantive activity.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in VUV – Vanuatu has no statutory transfer pricing regime, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no VUV-denominated documentation threshold. Nevertheless, if the IC is inserted into an international group, foreign parent and subsidiary tax authorities may require OECD-compliant transfer pricing documentation under CbC or local country rules; a prudent IC should prepare contemporaneous TP documentation for related-party animation services, licensing of IP, cost-sharing, and management fee flows.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently impose ESR-reviewed Economic Substance Regulations on a 3D animation IC as a domestic tax filing condition. However, the IC must still demonstrate genuine economic substance for anti-avoidance, anti-money laundering, and global CFC/GAAR purposes. Recommended commercial substance includes a physical or serviced office, documented decision-making for production contracts, real staffing or subcontracted animation capacity, complete accounting records, operating bank accounts, and actual expenditures attributable to the animation business. An offshore invoicing-only shell with no operational footprint is vulnerable to challenge by foreign taxing authorities and by VFSC under the IC Act's fit-and-proper standards.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Tax Representation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to conceal revenue from foreign tax authorities, falsely claiming a foreign tax exemption based on a non-existent Vanuatu DTA, submitting false declarations of non-residence, or routing 3D animation income through the IC without any genuine production activity by the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Vanuatu's criminal and AML/CFT laws, including fines, confiscation of all assets derived from the offending invoices, and imprisonment. The IC may be struck off; foreign tax authorities may impose unpaid tax, interest, and evasion penalties up to 100% or more of the understated tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors who sign false declarations or order the evasion scheme are personally liable for civil restitution, subject to travel bans and disqualification, and may be imprisoned together with the beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a registered IC with no office, no employees, no bank account, no board decisions, no project files, and no production records, while issuing large commercial animation invoices to overseas clients; using nominee directors solely to disguise the true principal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may refuse renewal, impose administrative penalties, and strike the company off the register. Foreign courts may pierce the corporate veil, recharacterize the IC as an agent or conduit, and assess tax, penalties, and interest against the parent or beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers may be personally liable for fraudulent or reckless trading, disqualified from managing ICs, and restrained from leaving Vanuatu while an investigation is pending.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify and disclose the ultimate beneficial owner, maintaining undisclosed nominee shareholdings, refusing to provide source-of-funds documentation, or transacting with sanctioned counterparties in the animation value chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary administrative penalties under Vanuatu AML/CFT regulations, freezing orders, suspension of the registered agent, and criminal penalties for money laundering if the animation revenues are the proceeds of predicate offences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company officers and compliance officers face criminal fines, imprisonment, personal confiscation orders, and prohibition from acting as directors of any Vanuatu regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Invalid Domestic Business Activity / IC Prohibited Activities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to trade with Vanuatu residents, rent local offices to clients, employ Vanuatu-resident staff without the appropriate licence, or acquire Vanuatu-situs assets in the IC name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Contracts made in breach of the IC Act may be void or unenforceable; the IC is liable to penalties, deregistration, and the loss of its tax-exempt offshore status; taxes may become payable under ordinary Vanuatu domestic law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors authorizing prohibited domestic business may be jointly and severally liable for the company's obligations arising from that business, and may be prosecuted for breach of the IC Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Collecting Vanuatu VAT on a domestic invoice without being VAT-registered, falsely claiming input VAT credits on exported animation services, issuing invoices from the IC for services actually rendered by another entity, or creating circular payments to manufacture deductible VAT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT evasion assessments, penalty tax up to twice the evaded VAT, criminal fines, and restriction orders; the tax authority may also audit related companies and impose joint assessments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors involved in the preparation or approval of false invoices face personal criminal liability, civil penalties, and disqualification orders; foreign tax authorities may additionally recover withholding and profit taxes from the directors as responsible persons.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing intercompany animation production services, IP licensing, or profit-splitting arrangements outside arm's length standards without contemporaneous analysis; stripping profits out of high-tax jurisdictions into the Vanuatu IC with no substantive functions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax authorities may impose transfer pricing adjustments, secondary adjustments, withholding tax recharacterization, interest, and penalties up to 100% of the adjustment; Vanuatu itself has no penalty, but the adjustment may expose the IC to anti-money laundering scrutiny if artificial round-tripping is used.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or implement non-arm's length agreements may be personally assessed under foreign director-liability and fraudulent conveyance rules; travel bans may issue in serious cross-border tax fraud cases.
